environment.initial_positions: same deterministic reset seeds across all model/interval cells
environment.success: existing FrankaAutonomousEnv criterion: lift >= 0.10m sustained for >=5 control steps

evaluation.order: sequential by model seed 42,123,456 and interval R1,R2,R4
evaluation.resume: append-safe partial CSV; validate complete schema, row values, unique ordered seeds, checkpoint and protocol hashes; preserve and stop on inconsistency

hypotheses.H1: R4 may outperform R1 because executing a temporally consistent four-action plan avoids unnecessary replanning.
hypotheses.H2: R1 may outperform R4 because frequent observations allow faster state-error correction.
hypotheses.H3: R2 may provide a compromise between temporal consistency and feedback frequency.
hypotheses.H4: R4 should require fewer BC inference calls; this need not reduce total episode runtime proportionally.

outcomes.primary: paired grasp success difference R4 minus R1 for each frozen BC model
secondary: R2 minus R1 and R4 minus R2

research_question: Does executing cached action chunks open-loop improve grasping success compared with replanning more frequently using the same trained action-chunked policy?

statistics.independence: do not treat shared evaluation positions as independent policy replications or 6000 rows as independently trained policies; only three BC training seeds; no population-level superiority claim
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction across the three per-model tests within each comparison family; R4-R1 designated primary
statistics.paired_difference_ci: 95% paired bootstrap interval over evaluation positions within each fixed model; conditional on fixed model and position distribution
statistics.paired_positions: same 2000 positions for all nine cells; per-model exact two-sided McNemar R4 vs R1 (primary), R2 vs R1 secondary, R4 vs R2 descriptive
statistics.regions: exploratory; fixed EN/ES/WN/WS boundaries from existing evaluation convention
statistics.seed_level: mean, median, sample SD, min, max, direction across three frozen BC seeds; descriptive only

stopping_conditions: Stop if checkpoint hash/provenance or normalization/configuration mismatch.
Stop if R4 fails historical outcome/episode-length/inference-count compatibility checks.
Stop and preserve partial files if schema, seed uniqueness/range/order, hashes, or paired initial positions are inconsistent.
Do not change model, environment, seed range, success criterion, or interval after inspecting new Final outcomes.
study: Frozen H4 BC Replanning Frequency Ablation
